propositions: Compaction was removed from the close path due to a 13m53s store write lock hold, leaving stores with no standing compaction trigger unless run manually via rebar compact
A scheduled 6-hourly GitHub Actions workflow provides amortized compaction where CI exists, but adopters using rebar as a library or CLI with no CI and no local cron have no compaction trigger at all

A two-arm selection mechanism (backfill for snapshot-less tickets with foldable events, recurrence for tickets exceeding foldable threshold) replaces one-time-only backfill and enables repeated compaction of grown tickets

An operation-linked trigger spawns a detached compaction worker after close completes and releases the store lock, using a stamped advisory lock to prevent concurrent workers and re-yield to foreground writers
The sweep's per-ticket git log walk for authorship ledger was performance-critical under the write lock and required hoisting out of lock scope and batching across all tickets
